authoritative_records.name: SourceProfile
authoritative_records.owns: versioned source-family interpretation, discovery rules, field aliases, source timezone/vocabulary semantics

authoritative_records.name: ImportRun
authoritative_records.owns: one processing attempt, selected source identity, parser/version context, bounded totals and result state

authoritative_records.name: SourceObservation
authoritative_records.owns: normalized allowlisted evidence from one exact source location/row/logical identity before domain acceptance

authoritative_records.name: SourceCheckpoint
authoritative_records.owns: accepted source-family chronology/fingerprint frontier, independent from domain chronology

authoritative_records.name: ReconciliationProposal
authoritative_records.owns: reviewable proposed differences and consequence classification against current accepted state

authoritative_records.name: ProposalDisposition
authoritative_records.owns: accepted/rejected/deferred/unresolved decision at the smallest governed scope

identity_rules: SourceObservation identity is not domain entity identity.
RFC/WFM adoption requires exact canonical identifiers; descriptive similarity never adopts.
WFM Task No. is canonical row/entity identity within supported source semantics.
Header identity comes from a versioned exact alias registry, never column position or fuzzy matching.
Logical fingerprint identity is based only on governed canonical allowlisted meaning.
history_rules: Import attempts, accepted observations, proposal decisions and domain lifecycle evidence remain separate histories.
A newer identical logical observation may update bounded source-recency/checkpoint evidence without fabricating domain history.
Equal source chronology with different logical content is a conflict, not last-write-wins.
Older source evidence requires an explicit recovery path rather than silently rewinding checkpoints.
